subject: VM evidence request — SIG & SOC2: scan cadence, retention, SLA attestation
messages:
From: Audrey Lane <audrey.lane@finserv.com>

Cc: security@finserv.com
Date: Thu, 18 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM evidence for SIG + SOC2 Q3 audit

Kimberly,

We're collecting vendor evidence for our upcoming SIG and SOC2 review. Can you provide the following items by tomorrow EOD PDT (May 19)?

- Confirmed scan cadence (authenticated vs unauthenticated) and scope (containers, infra, dependencies).
- SLA for triage/remediation for P1/P2 (we need measurable SLAs).
- Retention windows for raw scan artifacts and consolidated reports (SOC2 looks for 12+ months).
- A short attestation letter confirming the above items for inclusion in our audit binder.

If you have a central index or single archive of the evidence, please point us at it (we prefer a shared Drive link or DocuSign attestation). Also flag any expected exceptions (third-party libs, managed services) we should note.

Thanks,
Audrey
Audrey Lane
Vendor Risk Lead — FinServ Corp
Audrey.lane@finserv.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG + SOC2 Q3 audit

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear ask. We can meet your timeline and will deliver a scoped evidence packet by May 19 EOD PDT. Summary below, full details + artifacts attached.

Summary (quick bullets):
- Scan cadence: authenticated container & host scans: daily (scheduled nightly); unauthenticated/CT scanning of public endpoints: weekly. Dependency (SBOM) scans: on build + weekly dependency inventory review.
- SLA (definitions):
  * P1 / Critical (remote code exec or data exfiltration risk): initial triage within 6 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours; remediation target 14 calendar days unless customer-facing rollout required.
  * P2 / High: initial triage within 24 hours; remediation target 30 days.
  * We track mean time to remediation and provide a CVE closure manifest on request.
- Retention: raw scan artifacts (scanner outputs, logs, evidence snapshots): retained 13 months by default; consolidated reports & remediation manifests: retained 3 years. If you require longer retention for SOC2, we can export a certified snapshot.

Attachments included for handoff: vm_evidence_index.csv (index of artifacts), scan_schedule.pdf (cadence + toolchain), and a draft attestation letter we can sign. We'll place the full archive on a secure Drive link when final.

Clarifying Qs for scope: do you require evidence for our upstream model-hosting partners (managed infra) in this packet, or only Redwood-owned runtime & control-plane assets? That will affect the artifact set we include.

I copied Ben (sec ops) and Marissa (compliance) to confirm we have no outstanding long-lived exceptions before we hand this to you.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0123
